verdict.rationale: Elastic's marketing page says users can interact with their telemetry through natural language and describes an AI SRE that investigates incidents. Both are first-party claims of natural-language interaction, but they cover querying and investigation rather than operating the product broadly, and there are no detailed docs. Missing for 10: documented natural-language control of configuration, alerting, rules, dashboards and cases; in-depth first-party docs on the assistant; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Interact directly with your telemetry through natural language and resolve problems faster without switching tabs or context.
Elastic nightshift AI SRE detects and investigates incidents, delivering evidence-backed root cause.
